newsitem.title: USA: Sun Co Q3 shr $1.44 vs $0.87.
newsitem.headline: Sun Co Q3 shr $1.44 vs $0.87.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Qtr per share after provision for dividends on preference shares. 9 mths per share is for primary and fully diluted earnings
Qtr includes income from discontinued operations, $128 million vs $8 million, and effect of continuing operations, loss 11 million vs gain 70 million.
9 mths includes income from discontinued operations, $166 million vs $218 million
1995 9 mths includes cumulative effect of change in accounting principle, charge $87 million.

Excluding a $125 million after-tax gain on the sale of its international production business, Sun had an operating loss of $8 million in the current quarter ($0.26 per share). There were no special items in the third quarter of 1995.
